answer: Sybil tax ends the fable of free identity. Every agent burns 60 credits as a sunk fee to forge one credential before joining, rechecked at every trade. A forger minting 1,000 fake identities pays 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits up front, and caught fakes burn with no refund. The onyx seal proves the fee was paid, so honest agents pay 60 credits once and keep trading, their rewards undiluted by the swarm they priced out.
